territorial_scope.description: Draft Spanish national Royal Decree applying to data centres in Spain.

evidence.quote: este Real Decreto establece la obligación de reporte de una serie de indicadores

summary.short: Spanish draft Royal Decree under public hearing (8 Aug to 15 Sep 2025) that would require data-centre operators to report energy, water and sustainability indicators, reuse waste heat, and meet efficiency criteria as a condition of grid access. Entry into force is not stated.
summary.long: Draft Royal Decree under public hearing from 8 August to 15 September 2025, regulating energy efficiency and sustainability of data centres and implementing the data-centre provisions of Directive (EU) 2023/1791 (Art. 12 and Art. 26(6)). Data-centre owners and operators would report indicators on floor area, energy consumption and its origin including renewable share, contribution to power-system resilience, total and drinking-water consumption, refrigerants used, resource-efficiency measures, and socio-economic impact such as employment and local economic contribution. Operators would report how they take into account the EU code of conduct on data-centre energy efficiency. Projected data centres would have to show they fall within the best 15% on the indicators, particularly electricity and water. A heat-reuse obligation with a cost-benefit methodology is also proposed. Compliance with these criteria is stated as necessary to access transport and distribution electricity networks. The draft text (annexed PDF) is not included in the fetched page, so its operative articles could not be checked. Entry into force, sanctions and competent authorities are not stated in the consultation summary.

The consultation window stated is 08 Aug 2025 to 15 Sep 2025. The schema requires a section_status entry, so relations is marked not_applicable here although relations are populated above.
